posts.title: Art scans update Oct 2026
posts.description: I’ve uploaded a pile of extra scans to the archive. I’m trying to cherry pick cool, interesting or rare items where possible because realistically I can’t get through everything I have unless I was able to give up working.

posts.title: Irem 10L471G colour resistor repro
posts.description: Irem games from M72 up to and including M92 use custom resistor ladders for the colour mixing hardware, they tend to be found near KNA91H014 customs.
